introSection.title: Open Up Global Business Opportunities
paragraphs: RAKEZ (Ras Al Khaimah Economic Zone) is one of the most powerful business ecosystems in the UAE — providing a cost-effective, central, and flexible option for global entrepreneurs, SMEs, manufacturers, and startups.

Whether you're setting up a trading company, tech startup, consultancy, or manufacturing — RAKEZ provides the infrastructure, license combinations, tax incentives, and more to enable a successful UAE experience.

As a gateway to regional and global markets, RAKEZ combines the power of a world-class free zone with the benefits of a dynamic mainland economy. It supports over 18,000 companies from 100+ countries — and you could be next.

sidebarCard.title: Still Have Questions?

sidebarCard.whatsappMessage: Hi! I have a question about RAKEZ Free Zone.

items.q: How long does it take to register a company in RAKEZ?
items.a: It usually takes approximately 3-5 working days to register a company with RAKEZ, subject to business activity, documentation, and visa requirements. We fast-track the process to get your company registered without hiccups.

items.q: Can I own a company in RAKEZ as a foreigner?
items.a: Yes. RAKEZ allows 100% foreign ownership with no local Emirati sponsor required. You have complete control over your business operations, profits, and decision-making.

items.q: Do I need a physical office to set up in RAKEZ?
items.a: Not necessarily. RAKEZ offers flexible options including Smart Offices, Executive Suites, and shared workspaces. However, certain licenses and visa quotas may require a physical presence.

items.q: Is there a visa included in the company formation at RAKEZ?
items.a: RAKEZ license packages include visa eligibility. We handle investor visas, employment visas, family visas, Emirates ID, medical tests, and visa stamping — complete end-to-end support.

items.q: Can I open a bank account with a RAKEZ company in the UAE?
items.a: Yes. We provide complete assistance with UAE corporate bank account opening — including KYC documentation and bank liaison — as part of our setup services.

items.q: Is RAKEZ good for e-commerce and online businesses?
items.a: Absolutely. RAKEZ offers an E-Commerce License specifically designed for online stores, marketplaces, dropshipping, and digital product sellers — with full payment gateway integration support.

items.q: Is there a tax benefit in RAKEZ?
items.a: Yes. RAKEZ offers 0% personal and corporate income tax, no import/export duties, free repatriation of capital and profits, no currency restrictions, and UAE tax advisory with VAT registration.

items.q: Can I operate in both Free Zone and UAE Mainland with an RAKEZ company?
items.a: Yes. RAKEZ offers a Dual License option that combines Free Zone benefits with access to the UAE mainland — perfect for businesses wanting maximum market reach.

items.q: What if I need help post company set up?
items.a: We provide extensive post-license support including audit-ready bookkeeping, license renewal, legal drafting, payment gateway integration, banking documentation, and visa renewals with full PRO services.

items.q: Why should I choose Setup Zone Dubai for RAKEZ setup?
items.a: We provide end-to-end support — from business activity selection and domain name reservation to company registration, bank account, VAT, compliance, and digital growth services. Our track record speaks for speed, accuracy, and full transparency.
